content:
Oh, Beautiful One, Nefertiti, whose name itself sings of perfection,
We approach you with hearts full of admiration and deep affection.
You, who graced the throne with unparalleled beauty and grace,
Whose wisdom shone bright, illuminating time and space.

Mistress of Happiness, Adorned One, we feel your radiant glow,
A beacon of strength from long ages ago.
You who stood beside the sun, with a spirit so bold,
A woman of power, in stories yet untold.

We honor your memory, your serene and regal gaze,
For your legacy continues to shine through history's haze.
May the light of Aton, that once touched your golden skin,
Continue to inspire the beauty, the power, within.

May your spirit, vibrant and strong, gently descend,
To remind us of elegance, a strength that will transcend.
Bless us with your wisdom, your courage, your royal art,
To embody such grace in each beat of our heart.

Nefertiti, Queen of the Nile, timeless and grand,
May your eternal beauty bless this humble land.
We offer our love, our reverence, our unwavering acclaim,
Forever whispered, cherished, your magnificent name.
